title: Tracker links for one decomposition
description: The persistent reference from each harness key to its ticket, one file per decomposition at `docs/estate/tracker-links/<SLUG>.json`. It covers the decomposition's stories and the defects raised from them, which have no item file. Bookkeeping, not acceptance: no item gate reads it. Written by `jira-sync.mjs` in a pull request after it creates tickets; read by `check-trackers.mjs` and `jira-sync.mjs`.

epic.description: The Epic chosen or created for this decomposition, as `<instance-id>:<JIRA-KEY>`. Absent where the board's `epics` is `none`.

parent.description: A defect's parent story, the `key` of the validation block that minted the defect's key.
